Statistics student at Utah State University (B.S. expected December 2026, minors in Mathematics and Psychology), building toward a career in data science and analytics-driven business decisions. I plan to continue to a master's in data science.

I work with R, Python and SQL, and my projects cover relational database analysis, web scraping and data cleaning, Monte Carlo simulation, machine learning, and regression modeling. I like turning messy data into clear answers that someone can act on.

Outside the classroom, I spent two years as a full-time volunteer in Wisconsin, where I held leadership positions and coordinated logistics and training for 150+ people. I currently work in Home Depot's Kitchen Design department, where I use 20/20 design software to build customer quotes and turn their needs into practical kitchen plans.

See my [projects](projects.qmd) or [resume](resume.qmd).
